Do these providers sell a hosted compute sandbox or hosted compute capacity? For each, add a record with its price, free tier and identity cost, or record why it is not an offer.
An audit of the first attempt judged these claims unsupported by their sources; settle each one first:
- compute/nirvana-agent-sandboxes $.verdict: Pages show a paid, usage-billed product with no free allowance or trial credit; the record's own free_tier says none. A product with no free lane is paid-only (docs/compute/dead-ends.md), not qualifies-with-caveat.
- compute/nirvana-agent-sandboxes $.identity_cost.kind: The sign-up route returned an error page and the authentication page names only an organization API key issued from the dashboard. No capture shows email as the identity required.
- compute/volcengine-vci-agent-sandbox $.verdict: Pay-as-you-go billing by uptime and no free sandbox quota in any capture; the record's own free_tier says none. That is paid-only, not qualifies-with-caveat. (The signup page banner reads 注册获得免费体验 but names no VCI quota.)
- compute/jilebi $.verdict: Fresh read of jilebi.ai returned the same capture hash (aded4305 for the second capture). No free allowance or trial credit on the page; only pay-per-run rates. By the record's own free_tier, paid-only, not qualifies-with-caveat.
An audit of the first attempt judged these claims unsupported by their sources; settle each one first:
- compute/nirvana-agent-sandboxes $.verdict: Fresh read of nirvanalabs.io/startup-credits shows a published promotional credit programme ($1,000 Founders self-serve, $250 signup credit, up to $50,000 Agents tier covering agent sandboxes). The cited sandbox page says nothing about price or free access, so 'paid-only' is not established; credits
- compute/nirvana-agent-sandboxes $.free_tier.stated: Claim says no free quota or trial credit is published. Startup-credits page publishes $1,000 Founders credit (applies to agent sandboxes per terms) and $250 signup credit. Rates ($0.016/vCPU-h, $0.004/GB-h, 2 vCPU+4GB = $0.048/h) are correct per nirvanalabs.io/md.
- compute/nirvana-agent-sandboxes $.identity_cost.kind: Cited evidence does not say an institution is needed to register: the sign-up capture is an error page and the auth doc only names organization owners for API keys. Founders credit asks for business email and card, but no page says registration itself requires an institution.
- compute/volcengine-vci-agent-sandbox $.verdict: Signup page says 'register to get a free experience'; the cited VCI pages show pay-as-you-go billing but do not rule out a free trial, so 'paid-only' is not established. Beta features need enterprise verification for trial.
- compute/volcengine-vci-agent-sandbox $.free_tier.stated: Claim says no free quota is published; signup page advertises a free experience on registration (scope unstated). Billing text 'The billing cycle is accurate down to seconds, and bills are settled on an hourly basis.' and CNY 0.60 Professional hosting fee are accurate; $0.049/h is the list figure.
